replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello Ihze,

Unfortunatly we don't accept screenshots of messages over skype.
Skype is not an avicus service and therefor we can't control what happens over the messaging service.
And as ImRaging already said, please email support@avicus.net with valid evidence if you want to report a staff member.
Furthermore I would like to remind you that there are forum rules you have to follow (eg don't create spam threads)
This Appeal is Denied.

Regards Flo/resepignev.
